content:
mei: FYI we hit a duplicate-side-effect issue in the onboarding sampleapp. Long-running streaming request, token rotated mid-stream, chunk N returned 429, client retried entire stream and downstream webhook got called twice.

sam: Oof. Which SDK and sampleapp?

mei: Go sampleapp used by new customers. Repro: start streaming completion with prompt ~8k chars, sleep until token expiry, let client observe 429 on a chunk boundary. Client retries from start without stable idempotency key.

igor: Do other SDKs attach idempotency keys for streaming?

nora: Python + JS attach idempotency for non-streaming completions. Streaming parity is inconsistent. Go intentionally omitted because the stream connection model made it unclear where to put a single operation id.

mei: Suggested approach: send a stable idempotency header for the logical operation even for streaming (eg `x-rw-idempotency`) and have the runtime dedupe replays within a short grace window (configurable on the runtime). This avoids duplicate side-effects for retries caused by token refresh or transient 429s.

sam: We also need client-side backoff tuning. When token rotates we often see an immediate 429 -> immediate retry loop. Proposal: randomized jitter base backoff 300ms-1s then exp backoff up to 8s. Also add a small random offset per-process to avoid thundering herd.

igor: Implementation notes: Go SDK change should be small — generate a UUID at request start and attach both header and metadata on the stream handshakes. Add opt-in flag `EnableStreamIdempotency` and enable by default for the sampleapp release after runtime toggle.

nora: Runtime side: add a short-lived idempotency store keyed by (customer_id, model, idempotency_key) and a ttl of 30s. When a replay hits, return a `200` but with `x-rw-dedup: true` and the original response id. We should emit metrics `dedupe.requests`, `dedupe.hits` and labels for model and region.

mei: For onboarding docs: call out that function-calls or anything with out-of-band side-effects should be treated as non-idempotent unless the app provides its own keys. Add sample code for attaching `x-rw-idempotency` and a sample test harness that rotates token mid-stream to validate dedupe.

ci-bot: build(go-sdk/patch-stream-idempotency): unit tests ok, flaky e2e on linux-amd64, scheduling rerun.

sam: Can we add a small integration test in CI that simulates token refresh and asserts downstream webhook only receives one call? That will prevent regressions.

igor: I'll add a mux in the sampleapp test server that records webhook calls and asserts count==1 for the idempotency case.

nora: Also add a short note to the SDK parity board and a changelog item outlining the behavior and the feature toggle keys.

mei: I'll open DEVEX-805 for this work and attach PRs for go-sdk/sampleapp/docs. Planning to ship sampleapp fix + docs first, then coordinate runtime toggle.

sam: Thanks. Once PRs are up, ping #eng-runtime and we can enable the grace-window in canary for a couple hours and monitor dedupe metrics. :thumbsup:
